project_type: Python Telegram bot using aiogram 3.x with Firebase Realtime DB
build_system: pip with requirements.txt, deployed on Railway (Procfile)
verification_instructions: 1. Run AST parse to verify syntax. 2. Check that all imports resolve. 3. Verify logic correctness by reading the code.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages or run bot. Use AST validation only.
contribution_requirements: Single file bot.py, all code in one file
key_patterns: Firebase CRUD via db_get/db_set/db_update/db_push/db_delete. All UI uses ReplyKeyboardMarkup via _kb() helper. Admin panel uses AdminFlow StatesGroup. Order IDs currently come from Firebase push (auto-generated keys like -NxAbCdEf). Products stored under 'products/' in Firebase with auto keys. Orders under 'orders/', 'vpn_orders/', 'proxy_orders/'.
directory_structure: Single file project: bot.py (6800 lines), requirements.txt, Procfile, railway.toml
